question: 单项选择：I _____ my homework before my mother came home. A. finish  B. finished  C. had finished  D. will finish
answer: 答案：C. had finished。解析：before my mother came home（过去时），主句用过去完成时，表示"过去的过去"。

question: 单项选择：By the time I got to the station, the train _____. A. leaves  B. left  C. has left  D. had left
answer: 答案：D. had left。解析：By the time + 过去时，主句用过去完成时。

question: 用所给词的适当形式填空：She ______ (read) the book before she watched the movie.
answer: 答案：had read。解析：before she watched是过去时，从句用过去完成时。完整：She had read the book before she watched the movie.

question: 单项选择：I _____ the film before, so I didn't want to watch it again. A. see  B. saw  C. had seen  D. will see
answer: 答案：C. had seen。解析：I didn't want是一般过去时，从句用过去完成时表示"过去的过去"。

question: 翻译句子：到去年年底为止，我已经学了英语五年了。
answer: 答案：By the end of last year, I had learned English for five years. 解析：By the end of last year是过去时间，主句用过去完成时。

question: 单项选择：He told me that he _____ his work. A. finish  B. finished  C. has finished  D. had finished
answer: 答案：D. had finished。解析：told是过去时，从句用过去完成时。

question: 用所给词的适当形式填空：I ______ (have) lunch before I went shopping.
answer: 答案：had had。解析：before I went是过去时，从句用过去完成时。have的过去分词是had。完整：I had had lunch before I went shopping.

question: 单项选择：By the time the teacher came, the students _____ the classroom. A. clean  B. cleaned  C. have cleaned  D. had cleaned
answer: 答案：D. had cleaned。解析：By the time + 过去时，主句用过去完成时。

question: 翻译句子：她说她已经完成了工作。
answer: 答案：She said that she had finished her work. 解析：said是过去时，从句用过去完成时。

question: 单项选择：When I arrived at the party, everyone _____. A. leaves  B. left  C. has left  D. had left
answer: 答案：D. had left。解析：When I arrived是一般过去时，主句用过去完成时（已经离开）
